data.name: The Bank of Punjab
data.description: The Bank of Punjab was constituted pursuant to The Bank of Punjab Act, 1989. It was given the status of a scheduled bank by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) on September 19, 1994. It is principally engaged in commercial banking and related services. The majority shares of the Bank are held by Government of the Punjab (GoPb).
